title: Sebi revises margin requirements for commodity derivatives
summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has introduced new guidelines for commodity derivatives, establishing a minimum initial margin of 6%, 8%, and 10% based on commodity volatility. The risk margin timeline is confined to two days for low and medium volatility, while high volatility spans three days. This regulatory update will impact both agricultural and non-agricultural commodities and is set to be implemented by December 1, 2026.
